links.effect: Medical personas improved critical-care performance by up to $\sim+20\%$, but degraded primary-care performance by comparable margins.
links.quote: We find systematic, context-dependent, and non-monotonic effects: Medical personas improve performance in critical care tasks, yielding gains of up to $\sim+20\%$ in accuracy and calibration, but degrade performance in primary-care settings by comparable margins.
